_comment: Mapping from W3C ACT Rules to a11y-agent rules, in the many-to-many form the ACT Rules Format allows.
A selector is 'ruleId' or 'ruleId#check', where 'check' narrows to one sub-check of a rule so a single
rule can implement several ACT rules and still be scored precisely.
claimed=true declares the ACT rule as fully automated in our implementation: those rules make up the
headline accuracy figure. claimed=false rules are judgement calls that ACT expects a tool to answer
'cannot tell' on; we still run and report them, separately.
